summary: Physical iPhone scanner validation has not happened; Chromium/WebKit emulation does not replace it.
No authenticated flow has been exercised against Production since M7.1; remote-security-check phase 2 needs an invite token.
Database backup is validated; restore is not. A plain psql replay of a dump yields an insecure database (P130-07).
Native-checks in CI is typecheck, lint and unit tests only; emulator journeys and iOS runtime run locally or not at all.
